arxiv-2001-06637.creator: L. D. Kong 1,2 * , S. Zhang 1 * , Y. P. Chen 1 * , L. Ji 3 , S. N. Zhang 1,2 , Y. R. Yang 1 , L. Tao 1 , X. Ma 1 , J. L. Qu 1,2 , F. J. Lu 1 , Q. C. Bu 1,3 , L. Chen 4 , L. arxiv-2001-06637.description: Abstract A new black hole X-ray binary (BHXRB) MAXI J1535-571 was discovered by MAXI during its outburst in 2017. Using observations taken by the first Chinese X-ray satellite, the Hard X-ray Modulation Telescope (dubbed as Insight -HXMT), we perform a joint spectral analysis (2-150 keV) in both energy and time domains.

arxiv-2104-13190.description: Abstract Industrial Information Technology (IT) infrastructures are often vulnerable to cyberattacks. To ensure security to the computer systems in an industrial environment, it is required to build effective intrusion detection systems to monitor the cyber-physical systems (e.g., computer networks) in the industry for malicious activities.

arxiv-2106-09087.title: Hidden Sectors from Multiple Line Bundles for the B − L B-L MSSM
arxiv-2106-09087.creator: Anthony Ashmore, Sebastian Dumitru and Burt A. Ovrut, [0.8cm] Enrico Fermi Institute & Kadanoff Center for Theoretical Physics [.1cm] University of Chicago, Chicago, IL 60637, USA, [0.4cm] Sorbonne Université, LPTHE, [.1cm] F-75005 Paris, France, [0.4cm] Department of Physics, University of Pennsylv
arxiv-2106-09087.description: Abstract We give a formalism for constructing hidden sector bundles as extensions of sums of line bundles in heterotic M M -theory. Although this construction is generic, we present it within the context of the specific Schoen threefold that leads to the physically realistic B − L B-L MSSM model.

arxiv-2307-04869.creator: Gaurav Bagwe, Xiaoyong Yuan, Miao Pan, Lan Zhang
arxiv-2307-04869.description: Abstract Federated continual learning (FCL) learns incremental tasks over time from confidential datasets distributed across clients. This paper focuses on rehearsal-free FCL, which has severe forgetting issues when learning new tasks due to the lack of access to historical task data.

arxiv-2403-04875.description: Abstract . Sequential recommender models work with chronologically ordered sequences of interactions, to predict the next interaction in the sequence. Recently, adaptations of Transformer models, such as BERT4Rec and SASRec, have achieved state-of-the-art performance in the next-item prediction task according to accuracy-based metrics, such as NDCG.

arxiv-2501-02324.title: Traversable Wormhole in AdS and Entanglement
arxiv-2501-02324.description: Abstract A traversable wormhole generally violates the averaged null energy condition, usually requiring exotic matter. Recently, it has been found that the traversable wormhole can be realized by non-exotic matter in Einstein-Dirac-Maxwell theories in flat space. This paper generalizes discussions to the AdS spacetime and finds traversable wormholes with spherical and planar topologies.

arxiv-2511-00170.title: AmpliconHunter2: a SIMD-Accelerated In-Silico PCR Engine
arxiv-2511-00170.creator: Rye Howard-Stone \ORCID 0009-0005-7518-1867, Ion I. Măndoiu \ORCID 0000-0002-4818-0237
arxiv-2511-00170.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Rye Howard-Stone \ORCID 0009-0005-7518-1867, Ion I. Măndoiu \ORCID 0000-0002-4818-0237. Summary: We present AmpliconHunter2 (AHv2), a highly scalable in silico PCR engine written in C that can handle degenerate primers and uses a highly accurate melting temperature model. AHv2 implements a bit-mask IUPAC matcher with AVX2 SIMD acceleration, supports user-specified mismatches and 3’ clamp constraints, calls amplicons in all four primer pair orientations (FR/RF/FF/RR), and optionally trims primers and extracts fixed-length flanking barcodes into FASTA headers.

arxiv-2602-16167.title: Muon with Spectral Guidance: Efficient Optimization for Scientific Machine Learning
arxiv-2602-16167.creator: Binghang Lu, Jiahao Zhang, Guang Lin
arxiv-2602-16167.description: Abstract Physics-informed neural networks and neural operators often suffer from severe optimization difficulties caused by ill-conditioned gradients, multi-scale spectral behavior, and stiffness induced by physical constraints. Recently, the Muon optimizer has shown promise by performing orthogonalized updates in the singular-vector basis of the gradient, thereby improving geometric conditioning.

pmc-13344841.title: Hypercontractile phenotype at rest in chronic coronary syndromes predicts impaired functional reserve and increased mortality
pmc-13344841.creator: Quirino Ciampi, Yi Wang, Lauro Cortigiani, Angela Zagatina, Ratnasari Padang, Garvan C Kane, Hector R Villarraga, Adelaide M Arruda-Olson, Elena Kalinina, Jorge Lowenstein, Rosina Arbucci, Diego M Lowenstein Haber, Sofia Marconi, Jelena Celutkiene, Alla Boshchenko, Tamara Ryabova, Hugo Rodriguez-Zan
pmc-13344841.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). IntroductionTransthoracic echocardiography (TTE) identifies a hypercontractile phenotype (HP) in chronic coronary syndromes (CCS), characterized by elevated resting left ventricular (LV) elastance (force = systolic blood pressure/end-systolic volume). To evaluate the prognostic significance and functional correlates of HP.MethodsIn a prospective multicentre study, 10 677 patients with CCS underwent resting TTE to assess LV ejection fraction (EF), stroke volume, and force by quantitative volumetric echocardiography. All patients were followed for the endpoint of all-cause mortality.

pmc-13477015.title: Dynamic regulation of proteostasis underlies thermopriming-mediated acquired thermotolerance in Arabidopsis
pmc-13477015.creator: Mayur Bajaj, Annapurna Devi Allu, Basuthkar J Rao
pmc-13477015.description: Rapid climate change necessitates the development of heat-resilient plants. Elevated temperatures disrupt cellular protein homeostasis (proteostasis), and its timely restoration is crucial for plant survival following heat stress. Thermopriming, defined as pre-exposure to sublethal heat stress, has emerged as a promising strategy for enhancing heat tolerance. However, the impact of thermopriming on proteostasis remains unclear.

pmc-13599067.title: Effect of ibuprofen premedication on intraoperative pain during vital pulp therapy in MIH-affected permanent molars: a triple-blind randomized clinical trial
pmc-13599067.creator: Reyhaneh Faghihian, Masoud Saatchi, Narjes Amrollahi, Mohammad Javad Tarrahi, Asal Ebrahimi, Sheida Bagheri
pmc-13599067.description: BackgroundAchieving adequate pain control during vital pulp therapy in children with molar-incisor hypo-mineralization (MIH) is challenging because of hypersensitivity and the difficulty of obtaining profound local anesthesia. This study evaluated the effect of ibuprofen premedication on intraoperative pain during vital pulp therapy in MIH-affected mandibular first permanent molars in children.

pmc-13642912.creator: Anietie E Aliu, Robert Stephen Kerrison, Afrodita Marcu
pmc-13642912.description: BackgroundIn the UK, women of Black African and Black Caribbean descent (‘Black women’) participate in breast screening at lower rates than White women, contributing to inequalities in breast cancer outcomes. This study explored Black women’s decision about participating in breast cancer screening.

uslaw-usc-t10-s8858.title: 10 U.S.C. § 8858 — Duties of prize master
uslaw-usc-t10-s8858.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t10-s8858.description: United States Code, Title 10 (Armed Forces); Part IV (General Administration); Chapter 883 (Prize). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The prize master shall take the captured vessel to the selected port. On arrival he shall— (1) deliver immediately to a prize commissioner the documents and papers and the inventory thereof; (2) make affidavit that the documents and papers and the inventory thereof.
